verdict.rationale: Agent-oriented docs are a fair question for a public service with a large documentation site, so the axis applies. Direct probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404) and no markdown versions of doc pages (HTTP 404), and the MeF developer material is registration-gated PDF publications rather than agent-oriented docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
